anomalies.observed: The anodes of D18, D20, and D32 are tied together on /NET0110, but /NET0110 has no other nodes and is not connected to +3V3 or any other supply.
anomalies.expected: Status LEDs driven by CM4 active-low Ethernet/activity outputs should have their anodes connected to a supply rail (normally +3V3), as other LEDs on the board are.
anomalies.impact: The Ethernet link LEDs and Pi activity LED will not light because their common anode node is floating; intended visual status indication is lost.

anomalies.observed: Both the isolated-side ground pin (GND2, pin 5) and the logic-side ground pin (GND1, pin 4) of the isolated CAN transceivers U30 and U35 are connected to the same GND net.
anomalies.expected: For an isolated CAN transceiver/bus, GND2 should be a separate isolated ground domain, not tied to GND1/GND; the specification states the board implements isolated CAN buses through isolated CAN transceivers.

evidence.quote: two isolated CAN buses (`CAN0`, `CAN1`), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (`U8`, `U9`) through an isolated CAN transceiver (`U11`/companion)

anomalies.impact: The CAN buses are not galvanically isolated as intended, removing the isolation barrier and increasing susceptibility to ground loops/noise between the rover compute board and motor/actuator CAN devices.

anomalies.observed: R22 is given the schematic value 24k, but its description and MPN identify a 24Ω resistor.
anomalies.expected: A resistor across the VOUTP/VOUTN clamp/bleeder network should have a consistent high-impedance value; the 24k value is consistent with the surrounding 51k/249k divider and the SPICE deck, while 24Ω would be a heavy load.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R22") (value "24k") ... (description " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS") ... (field (name "MPN") (value "FRC0805J240TSD")))

anomalies.impact: If assembled from the MPN/description rather than the schematic value, R22 would load VOUTP/VOUTN by 1000x, potentially overheating, altering the clamp/protection behavior, and possibly damaging the associated bridge/rectifier path.

parsed.summary: The design files contain at least one clear connectivity anomaly: D18/D20/D32 LED anodes are left floating on /NET0110, so those status LEDs cannot operate. Supporting evidence also shows isolated CAN transceiver grounds tied together and a resistor value/MPN mismatch on R22.
